name: Dylan's Flags of the World
subtitle: Every flag, what it means, and the flag game
description: All 195 flags of the world: the flag of the day, every flag by continent (tap one for what its colors and symbols mean, its history, its earlier versions, its capital, people, size, languages, money, neighbors and a map), and a quiz that remembers which flags you know.
More kinds of flags too: US states, Canadian provinces, Australian states, cities, organizations, ship signal flags, pirate flags and signal flags, each with what it means.
Then the flag game: pick the answer (A, B, C or D) and press Enter; right turns green, wrong turns red. Countries by default (all fifty, easy ones first), or pick another kind.
features: What every flag's colors and symbols mean, and its history
States, cities, ship signals, pirate flags and more
The flag game: countries or any kind
